name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Light, airy pancakes with a golden crust and soft buttermilk crumb.
steps: Whisk flour, baking powder, sugar and salt together in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, beat eggs with buttermilk and vanilla extract.
Combine wet and dry ingredients gently — do not overmix, small lumps are fine.
Melt a little butter on a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook until bubbles form on top, about 2 minutes.
Flip and cook another 1-2 minutes until golden. Serve warm with syrup.

name: Garden Vegetable Omelette
description: A protein-packed omelette loaded with bell peppers, onion and tomato.
steps: Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper until fluffy.
Sauté diced onion and bell pepper in butter until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add chopped tomato and cook 1 more minute.
Pour eggs over the vegetables and let set on medium-low heat.
Sprinkle cheese on one half, fold the omelette over and slide onto a plate.

name: Honey Banana Overnight Oats
description: No-cook oats soaked overnight with milk, honey and banana.
steps: Combine oats, milk, chia seeds and cinnamon in a jar.
Mash half the banana and stir it in with the honey.
Cover and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours).
Top with sliced banana before serving.

name: Classic Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce — a bold weekend brunch.
steps: Sauté onion, garlic and bell pepper in olive oil until soft.
Stir in cumin and paprika, cook until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thickened.
Make small wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them.
Cover and cook until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny, about 6 minutes.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap
description: Crisp romaine, grilled chicken and Caesar dressing rolled in a soft tortilla.
steps: Season chicken breast with salt, pepper and garlic, then grill until cooked through.
Slice the chicken into strips.
Toss chopped romaine with Caesar dressing and shaved parmesan.
Lay the salad and chicken onto a warm tortilla and roll tightly.
Slice in half and serve.

name: Sesame Vegetable Stir-Fry
description: A crunchy medley of vegetables tossed in a savoury sesame-soy glaze.
steps: Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat.
Add garlic and ginger, stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add broccoli, carrot and bell pepper; stir-fry 4-5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Pour in soy sauce and toss to coat.
Serve hot over steamed rice.

name: Hearty Red Lentil Soup
description: A comforting, protein-rich soup simmered with warm spices.
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and garlic until softened.
Stir in cumin and toast for 30 seconds.
Add lentils and vegetable broth, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes until lentils are tender.
Blend partially for a creamy texture and finish with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Triple-Decker Club Sandwich
description: Toasted bread layered with chicken, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo.
steps: Toast the bread slices until golden.
Cook bacon until crisp and grill or pan-fry chicken until done.
Spread mayonnaise on the toast.
Layer lettuce, tomato, chicken and bacon between the three bread slices.
Secure with toothpicks and slice diagonally.

name: Creamy Butter Chicken
description: Tender chicken simmered in a rich, spiced tomato-butter gravy.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garlic, ginger and spices for at least 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken until charred and cooked through.
In a pan, melt butter and cook tomato puree with garam masala until thick.
Stir in cream and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken to the sauce and simmer until warmed through.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

name: Garlic Beef & Broccoli
description: Thin-sliced beef and broccoli in a glossy garlic-soy sauce.
steps: Slice beef thinly against the grain and toss with cornstarch.
Sear beef in a hot pan until browned; set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli, garlic and ginger until crisp-tender.
Return beef to the pan, add soy sauce and toss to combine.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Homemade Margherita Pizza
description: A classic pizza with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil.
steps: Preheat oven to the highest setting with a pizza stone or tray inside.
Roll out the dough on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce mixed with a little garlic over the base.
Add torn mozzarella pieces evenly.
Bake 8-10 minutes until the crust is golden and cheese bubbles.
Finish with fresh basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Herb-Grilled Salmon
description: Flaky salmon fillets grilled with lemon, garlic and fresh herbs.
steps: Pat salmon fillets dry and rub with olive oil, garlic, salt and pepper.
Preheat grill or pan to medium-high heat.
Grill salmon skin-side down for 4-5 minutes.
Flip and cook another 3-4 minutes until just cooked through.
Garnish with fresh dill and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Fragrant Vegetable Biryani
description: Layered basmati rice and spiced vegetables cooked to fragrant perfection.
steps: Parboil basmati rice with whole spices until 70% cooked; drain.
Sauté onions until golden, add vegetables and biryani masala, cook until tender.
Stir in yogurt and simmer briefly to form a thick masala.
Layer the rice over the vegetable masala in a heavy pot.
Top with mint, cover tightly and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Gently fluff and serve hot.

name: Loaded Cheesy Nachos
description: Crunchy tortilla chips piled high with cheese, beans and salsa.
steps: Spread tortilla chips on a baking tray.
Scatter black beans and shredded cheese generously over the chips.
Bake at 200°C for 6-8 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with diced tomato, onion, jalapeño and a dollop of sour cream.

name: Crispy Golden Fries
description: Twice-cooked potato fries, crunchy outside and fluffy inside.
steps: Cut potatoes into even sticks and soak in cold water for 30 minutes.
Pat dry, then fry at a low temperature (150°C) until soft but pale.
Remove and let rest, then fry again at high temperature (190°C) until golden and crisp.
Toss with salt and paprika while hot.

name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
description: Layers of creamy yogurt, granola and fresh berries.
steps: Spoon a layer of yogurt into a glass.
Add a layer of granola, then a layer of mixed berries.
Repeat the layers until the glass is full.
Drizzle with honey before serving.

name: Molten Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Rich chocolate cake with a warm, gooey molten centre.
steps: Melt dark chocolate and butter together until smooth.
Whisk eggs and sugar until pale and thick, then fold into the chocolate mixture.
Gently fold in flour and vanilla extract.
Pour into greased ramekins and bake at 200°C for 10-12 minutes.
Let rest 1 minute, then invert onto a plate and serve immediately.

name: Classic Tiramisu
description: Espresso-soaked ladyfingers layered with a silky mascarpone cream.
steps: Whisk egg yolks and sugar until pale, then fold in mascarpone until smooth.
Whip egg whites to soft peaks and fold gently into the mascarpone mixture.
Quickly dip ladyfingers in cooled espresso and layer in a dish.
Spread half the mascarpone cream over the layer; repeat with a second layer.
Dust generously with cocoa powder and chill at least 4 hours before serving.

name: Moist Banana Bread
description: A soft, moist loaf made with ripe bananas and warm cinnamon.
steps: Mash ripe bananas in a large bowl.
Beat in melted butter, eggs and sugar until combined.
Fold in flour, baking soda and cinnamon until just mixed.
Pour into a greased loaf tin and bake at 175°C for 50-55 minutes.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes before slicing.
